{{recipesummary
| category = Bread recipes
| Yield = 14 corn sticks
| time = 1 hour
| difficulty = 2
}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Bread|Bread]]
==Ingredients==

*1 [[cookbook:Cup|cup]] (240 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Cornmeal|cornmeal]]
*1 cup (240 ml) all-purpose [[cookbook:flour|flour]]
*4 [[cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
*½ tsp [[cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*1 cup (240 ml) [[cookbook:Milk|milk]]
*1 [[cookbook:Egg|egg]]
*¼ cup (60 ml) [[cookbook:shortening|shortening]]
*¼ cup (60 ml) [[Cookbook:sugar|sugar]] (optional)
*½ can (7.5 ounces / 212 g) whole [[cookbook:corn|corn]] (optional), drained

==Procedure==

# Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Grease a corn stick pan well, and preheat inside the oven. Cast iron works best.
# Combine corn meal, flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a large mixing bowl.
# Add egg, sugar, and shortening. [[cookbook:Beat|Beat]] until fairly smooth (about 1 minute).
# Pour into the hot, well-greased cornstick pan.
# [[cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 15–20 minutes until golden brown. If corn is added to batter, increase time a little.
# Serve hot and buttered.
